# Footprint-Creater

> Automatic building footprint extraction from high-resolution orthophotos. HRNet semantic segmentation with block-wise inference, geometry-aware post-processing, and a Flask console with per-stage previews. Outputs georeferenced Shapefiles.

Given a georeferenced orthophoto (`.tif`), this project produces a building
outline `.shp`. The pipeline is: block-wise AI inference, global mask merge,
global contour validation, then regularisation. The last two steps are what
separate it from "run a segmentation model and convert pixels to polygons":
raw masks produce jagged edges, merged blobs, and slivers that are unusable in
GIS without shape validation and geometry cleanup.

Three design constraints drive the architecture: large images do not fit in GPU
memory (hence 1024 px sliding windows with 50% overlap); stitching seams create
false contours (hence validation happens globally, before simplification, not
per tile); and orthophoto black borders are systematically misclassified as
buildings (hence Nodata, vegetation, and shadow masks are applied before
inference and enforced after it).

## Entry points

- `extract_buildings.py` - extraction core: model loading, block inference,
  global validation, smoothing, simplification, shapefile export.
- `web_app.py` - Flask console (routes, task scheduler, inline HTML/JS frontend).
  Run with `python web_app.py`, serves on port 5000.
- `scripts/download_models.py` - downloads pretrained weights from GitHub
  Releases with SHA256 verification.
- `docs/Algorithm_Logic.md` - detailed algorithm and parameter documentation.

## Pretrained weights

| File | Backbone | Size | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `iter_40000.pth` | HRNet-W32 + FCNHead | ~231 MB | default, faster |
| `hrnet_w48_iter_6000.pth` | HRNet-W48 + FCNHead | ~542 MB | higher quality, ~2x slower |

Hosted as GitHub Release assets under tag `models-v1`, not in git.

## Key parameters

`BLOCK_SIZE` 1024, `BLOCK_OVERLAP` 512, `MIN_AREA_M2` 100.0,
`BUFFER_EXPAND_M` 0.6, `BUFFER_SHRINK_M` 0.3, `SIMPLIFY_TOL` 0.3,
`RECT_IOU_THRESH` 0.90.
